name: agnes-agent-workspace
description: Agnes Agent Workspace — Web-based Agent workbench

scripts.predev: npm run build -w @agnes/agent-core && npm run build -w @agnes/prompts && npm run build -w @agnes/tools
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @agnes/server" "npm run dev -w @agnes/web"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run dev:kill && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agnes/agent-core && npm run build -w @agnes/prompts && npm run build -w @agnes/tools && npm run build -w @agnes/server && npm run build -w @agnes/web
